scope: Real deployed workerd, two SQLite Durable Objects, fake financial authority only. No Hyperdrive, Postgres, Stripe, AWS, models or real funds.

password.note: Date.now did not advance during native crypto; these zero readings do not measure CPU. The default hash and verify completed in one live request without memory/CPU errors. Larger stored hash parameters and concurrent password traffic were not load-tested.

cost.note: Eight bounded HTTP probes, two deployments and transient DO storage; estimate, not invoice. No resources retained.
